styleGuide.name: Mini Xiyou dark mythic black-gold art direction
styleGuide.promptAnchor: dark mythic Journey to the West fantasy, cinematic Chinese game concept art, ink-wash atmosphere with rich depth, imperial gold highlights, restrained vermilion accents, jade spiritual glow, ornate but readable silhouettes, dramatic lighting, premium mobile RPG key art, coherent black-gold UI compatibility
styleGuide.avoid: modern objects, western medieval armor, neon sci-fi palette, washed-out beige parchment dominance, cluttered unreadable backgrounds, excessive red saturation, text, logos, watermarks, UI mockups, duplicate limbs, distorted hands, blurry faces

replacement.simple: Overwrite the existing file with a new image using the same filename and compatible dimensions. The frontend and backend will continue to load the same /static/assets/images/... path.
replacement.versioned: Add a new local image file and update this manifest plus the corresponding frontend/backend path reference during a controlled asset update.
replacement.notes: Background, activity, and reward slots are intentionally reserved for later. Current enemies temporarily share leopard/rhino spirit art until dedicated enemy art is supplied.
